name: OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.main_theorem
type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ ε R lower : ℝ)
  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree) (m : ℕ → ℕ)
  (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ σ →
      0 < ε →
        0 ≤ R →
          LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.LowerBounded f lower →
              LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f
                  g σ →
                (∀ (c : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun η => η c) ↑P = ↑μ) →
                  T.WellFormed →
                    T.IsMainBranch m →
                      LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SampleIndependent T m (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.stepSize L σ ε R) x0 g
                          ↑P →
                        LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
                          LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
                            ∀ (K : ℕ),
                              4 * (R + 1) * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε + 8 * σ ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / ε ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                                (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                      (fun η =>
                                        ‖gradient f
                                              (T.vertex (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.stepSize L σ ε R) x0 g η (m k))‖ ^
                                          2)
                                      ↑P) ∧
                                  1 / ↑K *
                                      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
                                        ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                          ‖gradient f
                                                (T.vertex (OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.stepSize L σ ε R) x0 g η (m k))‖ ^
                                            2 ∂↑P ≤
                                    ε
